title: OpenClaw Autonomous Coding: Let Your Agent Fix Bugs and Open PRs While You Sleep
summary: Set up OpenClaw's GitHub skill to fix bugs, run tests, and open pull requests overnight. A step-by-step tutorial for autonomous coding with Blink Claw.
body_markdown: Blink Claw costs from about $45/month per agent for the always-on machine, with a choice of 13 AI models. AI model usage is billed from your workspace credits on top of that. LLM costs for a typical overnight bug-fix session (reading context, writing fix, running tests) run $0.05–$0.30 per fix depending on model and codebase size. At that rate, 30 overnight fixes per month costs roughly $6–$9 in model usage.
